candidates.headline: 15% off your favorite Starter Kit
candidates.rationale: Cross‑sell by offering a 15% discount on SKU‑A02 to encourage new customers to try our starter kit and discover complementary products.

candidates.headline: Rs200 off when you buy two or more items
candidates.rationale: Incentivize new shoppers to add complementary items to their cart by giving a Rs200 discount on orders with at least two qualifying products.

candidates.headline: Bundle Pack: SKU‑C02 + SKU‑C03 at 10% off
candidates.rationale: Promote cross‑sell by bundling two complementary items and giving a 10% discount on the bundle to new customers.

candidates.headline: Earn Rs100 loyalty credit with SKU‑F01
candidates.rationale: Reward new shoppers for purchasing a high‑margin SKU‑F01 by awarding Rs100 loyalty credit, encouraging repeat purchases.

candidates.headline: Your cart items are waiting!
candidates.rationale: Remind new customers of items they added to their cart to reduce abandonment and encourage completion of the purchase.

candidates.headline: 20% off SKU‑F02 just for you
candidates.rationale: Offer the maximum allowed discount on a high‑margin SKU‑F02 to new customers, driving cross‑sell while staying within the envelope.
